description: Compare two GitHub Actions workflow files and report what the change grants or removes. Permission scopes are ranked none, read and write, so a widening is reported and a narrowing is noted: only one of them grants something new. Also reports a privileged trigger added, a trigger removed, a permissions block removed so a default set elsewhere applies, an action moved from a commit to a mutable tag, an action version change, and a job removed so whatever it checked no longer runs. Pay 170000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

after.description: The later workflow. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
after.example:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request_target:
permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: third-party/upload@main

before.description: The earlier workflow. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
before.example:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

unchanged.description: True only when the triggers, permissions, jobs and actions were all identical.
